name: Vegetable omelette
description: Quick breakfast that uses up leftover vegetables from the fridge.
instructions:
1. Dice the bell pepper, tomato and onion.
2. Sauté them in oil for 3-4 minutes.
3. Beat the eggs with salt and pepper and pour them over the vegetables.
4. Cook on low heat until set.

name: Pancakes
description: Good for milk and eggs that are close to expiring.
instructions:
1. Whisk the eggs with the milk and sugar.
2. Gradually add the flour until you get a runny batter.
3. Cook the pancakes in a pan greased with a little oil.

name: Pasta with tomato sauce
description: Basic recipe for tomatoes that are too soft for a salad.
instructions:
1. Boil the pasta in salted water.
2. Sauté the onion and garlic, then add the chopped tomatoes and the tomato paste.
3. Simmer the sauce for 10 minutes, then mix it with the pasta.

name: Greek salad
description: No cooking, for fresh vegetables and an opened pack of feta.
instructions:
1. Chop the tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper and onion.
2. Add the feta in cubes.
3. Dress with oil, salt and lemon juice.

name: Chicken breast with rice
description: Simple lunch that keeps well in a lunch box.
instructions:
1. Cook the rice.
2. Slice the chicken breast into strips and brown it in oil.
3. Add the grated carrot and the bell pepper and cook 5 more minutes.
4. Serve over the rice.

name: Vegetable soup
description: Uses almost any leftover vegetables.
instructions:
1. Dice all the vegetables.
2. Boil them in 2 litres of salted water for about 30 minutes.
3. Add the tomato paste and the herbs at the end.

name: Country-style potatoes
description: Pan-fried potatoes with onion and ham.
instructions:
1. Boil the potatoes in their skins, then slice them.
2. Fry the onion and the ham.
3. Add the potatoes, brown them and sprinkle with dill.

name: Oatmeal with banana and yogurt
description: Breakfast for overripe bananas.
instructions:
1. Simmer the oats in the milk for 5 minutes.
2. Stir in the mashed banana.
3. Serve topped with yogurt.

name: Creamy mushrooms
description: Quick side dish, or a main course with bread.
instructions:
1. Sauté the onion and garlic in butter.
2. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they shrink.
3. Stir in the sour cream and parsley and cook 2 more minutes.

name: Hot sandwiches
description: For bread that is starting to dry out.
instructions:
1. Top each slice of bread with ham, tomato and cheese.
2. Bake for 10 minutes at 200°C.

name: Baked meatballs
description: They freeze well, useful when ground meat is close to expiring.
instructions:
1. Mix the meat with the egg, grated onion, garlic and salt.
2. Shape into meatballs and place them on a baking tray.
3. Bake for 25 minutes at 200°C.

name: Quick apple cake
description: For apples that have gone soft.
instructions:
1. Mix the eggs, sugar, yogurt and flour.
2. Fold in the grated apples.
3. Bake for 35 minutes at 180°C.

name: Garlic spinach with eggs
description: For fresh spinach, which wilts quickly.
instructions:
1. Sauté the garlic in butter.
2. Add the spinach and let it wilt.
3. Serve with fried eggs.

name: Zucchini fritters
description: Crispy fritters for a zucchini that is going soft.
instructions:
1. Grate the zucchini, salt it and squeeze out the water after 10 minutes.
2. Mix it with the eggs, flour and chopped dill.
3. Fry spoonfuls of the mixture in oil, 2-3 minutes on each side.

name: Banana yogurt smoothie
description: Two-minute breakfast for bananas with brown spots and yogurt near its date.
instructions:
1. Peel and slice the bananas.
2. Blend them with the yogurt and milk until smooth.
3. Serve cold.

name: Mushroom risotto
description: Creamy rice that uses up mushrooms and the last bit of cheese.
instructions:
1. Sauté the chopped onion and garlic in butter.
2. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their water.
3. Add the rice, then hot water a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 18 minutes.
4. Stir in the grated cheese and season with salt.

name: Chicken salad
description: Light lunch for lettuce and cucumber that won't last much longer.
instructions:
1. Season the chicken breast with salt and cook it in a pan, then slice it.
2. Tear the lettuce and chop the cucumber and tomatoes.
3. Mix everything and dress with oil and lemon juice.

name: Spinach and feta pasta
description: Fast dinner for spinach and an opened pack of feta.
instructions:
1. Boil the pasta in salted water.
2. Sauté the garlic in oil, then add the spinach until it wilts.
3. Mix in the drained pasta and the crumbled feta.

name: Mashed potatoes
description: Simple side dish for potatoes that are starting to sprout and milk near its date.
instructions:
1. Peel the potatoes and boil them in salted water for 20 minutes.
2. Drain and mash them with the butter.
3. Add the warm milk gradually and season with salt.

name: French toast with apples
description: Turns stale bread and soft apples into a sweet breakfast.
instructions:
1. Whisk the eggs with the milk and a little sugar.
2. Dip the bread slices and fry them in butter until golden.
3. Cook the sliced apples with the remaining sugar for 5 minutes and serve on top.
